biography.value: Heirs to divine power, empyreans are idealized beings of humanlike shape and godlike might. Their bond with their creators may resemble that of children and parents, servants and monarchs, creations and inventors, or something else entirely. Their existence is shaped by their patrons and by their ties to the heavenly gods of the Upper Planes or the fiendish gods of the Lower Planes, yet they keep their free will. Celestial empyreans are usually noble beings striving to prove worthy of their divine lineage, and many serve their parents or support those gods’ causes and champions. Fiendish empyreans are usually terrible, selfish villains bent on seizing their parents’ power: some raise unholy armies or rule secret realms in mockery of true gods, while others try to escape their cursed families.
